name: Watermark Robustness Stress Testing
description: This task evaluates the robustness of invisible watermarks embedded in AI-generated images against removal attacks while preserving image quality. The task includes two tracks: Black-box and Beige-box, simulating varying levels of attacker knowledge.

cr:input.name: ETI Benchmark Dataset
cr:input.description: A dataset of 600 images generated using Stable Diffusion 2.1 and Flux 1 [dev], with watermarks applied via in-processing and post-processing techniques. The dataset includes images with single and double watermarks, such as Gaussian Shading, StegaStamp, JigMark, PRC, StableSignature, and Trufo.
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The expected output is a set of attacked images where watermarks are removed or degraded while maintaining high visual quality. Outputs are evaluated on watermark detection performance and image quality degradation.

field.name: attacked_image
field.description: The attacked image after watermark removal attempts. Example: an image with reduced watermark visibility.

field.name: watermark_detection_score
field.description: The True Positive Rate (TPR) of watermark detection at 0.1% False Positive Rate (FPR). Example: 0.25 indicates 25% of watermarks remain detectable.

field.name: image_quality_score
field.description: The aggregated score representing image quality degradation. Example: 0.05 indicates minimal perceptible degradation.

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: Euclidean distance of Q and A scores
cr:evaluation.notes: The evaluation computes the Euclidean distance between image quality degradation (Q) and watermark detection performance (A). Lower scores indicate better performance.
